name: flyline-multishell +1
install:
set -euo pipefail

# The stock Cursor image ships rustup with a default toolchain (1.83.0) that predates
# Rust edition 2024. Both flycomp and flyline-multishell use edition = "2024": flyline
# pins 1.96.0 via rust-toolchain.toml, but flycomp has no pin and fails to even parse its
# manifest on the old default. Ensure rustup exists, then make 1.96.0 the environment
# default so flycomp (and anything else without a pin) builds.
if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}"
  export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}"
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal
  . "$CARGO_HOME/env"
fi
rustup toolchain install 1.96.0 --profile minimal -c clippy -c rustfmt
rustup default 1.96.0

# Warm dependency and build caches for both crates so agents start ready to build/test.
for repo in /agent/repos/flycomp /agent/repos/flyline-multishell; do
  if [ -f "$repo/Cargo.toml" ]; then
    cargo fetch --manifest-path "$repo/Cargo.toml"
    cargo build --manifest-path "$repo/Cargo.toml"
  fi
done
